Animal · 1 hex · SM +0 Giant Badger (Monsters on Automatic; answers SRD 5.1)

Low, wide and built entirely out of bad attitude, with digging claws that go through packed earth and will do the same to a boot. It would rather be underground than anywhere else. A party that opens up its sett gets everything the badger has, immediately, without a warning growl.

  • Every trait is drawn from the project's controlled GURPS vocabulary in scripts/srd/trait-library.mjs, which carries the page reference and published cost for each entry.
